write_up: Your resume tells a clear story: you moved from insurance account coordination into payroll support, then customer success at Brightline Payroll Software. A recruiter can see the customers you manage and the work you do with them, though your part in renewal strategy and escalations is less clear.

The onboarding checklist is a great model: you built something the whole CS team now uses. Your account book, quarterly business reviews and 2021 satisfaction score also give a recruiter concrete things to remember.

I'd expect a recruiter to move this forward for customer success roles with a couple of questions in hand. Let's start with the renewal line and show what you contributed, then give the same treatment to payroll escalations.
